name: Apothecary
description: A precise poisoner-healer who uses a silent blowpipe, weapon poisons, and salves. Supports the party with field medicine and clever alchemical prep.
suggestedSkills: Archery, Crafting, Nature, Lore, Perception, Insight, Education

recommendedTalents.name: Disciplined Archer
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re-roll one ranged attack per scene

recommendedTalents.name: Peak Performance
recommendedTalents.gloss: Pre‑buff one weapon or ammo: +1 weapon damage or +2 ammo damage until next rest

recommendedTalents.name: Field Medic
recommendedTalents.gloss: Better stabilize/treat injuries, quick battlefield care

recommendedCombatArts.name: Aimed Shot
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain +1 boon when you don’t move

recommendedCombatArts.name: Precise Shot
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Ignore armor and add Agility to damage

playstyle: The Apothecary rewards patience, setup, and smart resource use. Open from stealth with the silent blowpipe. Coat darts with Weapon Poison and use the blowpipe property to multiply the poison’s damage on strong/critical hits. Peak Performance lets you boost your darts (ammo) for +2 damage the whole day, turning small hits into meaningful chip. Field Medic makes you the team’s on‑site healer for stabilizing and treating injuries. Use Aimed Shot to land reliable first strikes and Precise Shot to punch through armor when needed.
advancement: Raise Archery 2-3 for more Combat Arts and consistency (Sharpshooter or Rapid Shot next). Push Nature 2-3 to deepen triage and wilderness sourcing, and Crafting 2-3 for stronger prep (Efficient Worker, Artisan, or Peak Performance 2). Add Lore for formula lore and Education for scholarly support. Consider Stealth later to exploit blowpipe ambushes with Assassination synergy.

name: Bard
description: A social performer who channels magic through music and story, inspiring allies and shaping encounters with illusions and charm effects.
suggestedSkills: Mysticism, Influence, Education, Survival, Perception, Nature, Stealth

recommendedTalents.name: Master of Principles
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re-roll a mystic rank 0 spell test once per scene

recommendedTalents.name: Inspire Ally
recommendedTalents.gloss: Quick Action: give an ally +1 boon on their next test

recommendedTalents.name: Eloquent Talker
recommendedTalents.gloss: Roll Education in place of Influence to persuade

playstyle: The Bard shines in social scenes and soft control. Use performance‑flavored rank 0 spells with Master of Principles to land key effects reliably. Calming Influence and veils shape tempo before blades are drawn. Inspire Ally fuels allies’ key rolls (and damage), while Eloquent Talker keeps you dominant in parley. You can still carry a shortsword, but your magic and words are your real weapons.
advancement: Raise Mysticism 2-3 to expand spells and reliability (Communal Practices next if you want multi‑target flexibility). Boost Influence 2-3 for stronger team support (Leading Presence is a great pick). Add Education/Lore for cultural/magical knowledge, and optionally Stealth for infiltration and stagecraft.

name: Barbarian
description: A devastating melee combatant who channels primal fury into brutal attacks, trading defense for raw power.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Athletics, Fortitude, Survival, Perception, Nature, Stealth

recommendedTalents.name: Heavy Weapon Mastery
recommendedTalents.gloss: No bane on Brutal Strike with heavy weapons

recommendedTalents.name: Bulky
recommendedTalents.gloss: +2 HP and +2 carrying capacity

recommendedTalents.name: Battle Rage
recommendedTalents.gloss: Enter rage for combat bonuses

recommendedCombatArts.name: Brutal Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Deal extra Strength damage with heavy weapons (no bane thanks to Heavy Weapon Mastery!)

recommendedCombatArts.name: Cleave
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Hit multiple enemies with your greataxe

playstyle: The Barbarian is perfect for players who want to deal massive damage and play aggressively, accepting risk for reward. Battle Rage provides combat bonuses while Heavy Weapon Mastery makes Brutal Strike attacks deadly without suffering banes. Bulky gives you extra HP to survive when rage runs out. Avoid heavy armor to maintain rage effectiveness. Use Cleave to hit multiple foes and Brutal Strike for single-target devastation.
advancement: Increase Battle Rage ranks for greater power, raise Fighting and Fortitude to rank 2-3 for more Combat Arts and resilience, add Survival for wilderness expertise, and consider Hard to Kill for survivability.

name: Brawler
description: A street-tough close-quarters fighter who dominates the clinch with fists, improvised weapons, and dirty tricks.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Fortitude, Streetwise, Influence, Perception, Stealth, Insight

recommendedTalents.name: Pugilist
recommendedTalents.gloss: Unarmed and brawling control. Treat fists and brawling weapons as reliable tools in a scrap

recommendedTalents.name: Hard to Kill
recommendedTalents.gloss: Shrug off punishment and stay standing in ugly brawls

recommendedTalents.name: Thug Tactics
recommendedTalents.gloss: Gain boons when ganging up or fighting dirty in tight quarters

recommendedCombatArts.name: Disarm
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Knock weapons from enemy hands to tilt the exchange

recommendedCombatArts.name: Snare
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Clinch and restrain with chain, whip, or grappling setups

playstyle: Close distance and take away your opponent’s best options. Use Fast Stride to enter clinch range, Disarm to strip weapons, and Snare to tie down priority targets while your allies dogpile. Pugilist keeps your hands and brawling tools effective even when you’re unarmed or improvised. Thug Tactics rewards advantage creation and teamwork in scrappy fights.
advancement: Raise Fighting 2-3 for more control arts (Supreme Disarm) and improved damage lines. Add Fortitude for toughness and recovery, and consider Streetwise 2 for better gang-up play. A spiked chain or whip can extend your control footprint once your technique improves.

name: Champion
description: A holy warrior combining divine magic with frontline combat, protected by heavy armor and faith.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Mysticism, Influence, Fortitude, Insight, Lore, Perception

recommendedTalents.name: Heavy Armor Mastery
recommendedTalents.gloss: Ignore movement penalty from heavy armor

recommendedTalents.name: Mystic Champion
recommendedTalents.gloss: Infuse a rank 0 mystic spell into a weapon attack

recommendedTalents.name: Leading Presence
recommendedTalents.gloss: Allies near you gain boons to Initiative and vs fear

recommendedCombatArts.name: Defensive Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain Defend Action effects on hit

recommendedCombatArts.name: Terrifying Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Frighten enemies with divine presence

playstyle: The Champion is perfect for players who want to be a holy warrior combining divine magic with frontline tanking. Use Mystic Champion to infuse spells into melee attacks and support allies. Heavy Armor Mastery will be crucial once you upgrade to scale or plate mail. Leading Presence makes you a natural party leader. Use Defensive Strike to stay alive and Terrifying Strike to control enemies.
advancement: Save coins to upgrade to Scale Mail (250) or Breastplate (750) and eventually Plate Harness (2,500), increase Fighting and Mysticism to rank 2-3 for more Combat Arts and spells, raise Fortitude for survivability, consider Shield Mastery or more divine-focused talents.

name: Duelist
description: A swift, precise blade fighter who wins through footwork, feints, and pinpoint strikes.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Athletics, Stealth, Influence, Perception, Streetwise, Education

recommendedTalents.name: Defensive Dueling
recommendedTalents.gloss: +1 Parry while wielding a single non‑heavy melee weapon and no shield

recommendedTalents.name: Fast Stride
recommendedTalents.gloss: Use Dash as Quick Action

recommendedTalents.name: Devious Tactics
recommendedTalents.gloss: Use Distract as a Quick Action. Feint via misdirection

recommendedCombatArts.name: Feint
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain +1 boon when not moving

recommendedCombatArts.name: Precise Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Ignore armor and add Agility to damage

playstyle: The Duelist is perfect for players who prefer agility and precision over brute force. Control distance with Fast Stride, use Feint to open defenses, and land Precise Strikes when it counts.
advancement: Increase Fighting and Athletics to rank 2-3, add Stealth or Influence depending on intrigue vs. street play, and consider Defensive Dueling or Riposte.

name: Druid
description: A nature spellcaster who shapeshifts and commands elemental forces through communion with the natural world.
suggestedSkills: Mysticism, Nature, Survival, Lore, Insight, Perception, Athletics

recommendedTalents.name: Shape Changer
recommendedTalents.gloss: Transform into animal forms

recommendedTalents.name: Animal Companion
recommendedTalents.gloss: Control an animal companion (Tier ≤ Nature)

recommendedTalents.name: Wilderness Expert
recommendedTalents.gloss: Excel at finding food and resources

recommendedCompanions.name: Bear
recommendedCompanions.gloss: Tough frontline with knockdown and grapple options and an intimidating roar.

recommendedCompanions.name: Bird
recommendedCompanions.gloss: Fast flying scout with keen eyes and dive attack bursts.

recommendedCompanions.name: Constrictor Snake
recommendedCompanions.gloss: Grapple and restrain to lock down priority targets.

playstyle: The Druid is perfect for players who want to blend with nature, shapeshift, and command elemental forces. Shape Changer provides incredible versatility, while Animal Companion gives you a loyal ally. Use nature magic to control the battlefield and support allies. Wilderness Expert makes wilderness travel easier for the whole party.
advancement: Increase Mysticism to rank 2-3 for more powerful spells and Shape Changer options, raise Nature and Survival for wilderness mastery, add Lore for deeper nature knowledge, and consider more shapeshifting or elemental talents.

name: Engineer
description: A siege and devices specialist who improvises tools, sets traps, and supports allies with clever engineering and thrown contraptions.
suggestedSkills: Crafting, Education, Archery, Lore, Perception, Fortitude, Streetwise

recommendedTalents.name: Quick Construction
recommendedTalents.gloss: Improvise items during exploration

recommendedTalents.name: General Education
recommendedTalents.gloss: No bane on untrained expert skills

recommendedTalents.name: Expert Slinger
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re-roll Supply checks for thrown weapons

recommendedCombatArts.name: Aimed Shot
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain +1 boon when not moving

recommendedCombatArts.name: Volley
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Hit multiple enemies with thrown weapons

playstyle: The Engineer is perfect for players who enjoy battlefield problem‑solving and logistics. Use Quick Construction to bolster defenses, create tools, and set simple traps. Deliver devices at range with Expert Slinger and support allies by shaping the field.
advancement: Increase Crafting to rank 2-3 for stronger builds, add Education and Perception for planning and scouting, raise Archery or Fighting depending on preferred delivery method, and consider Efficient Worker or Artisan talents.

name: Fighter
description: A reliable frontline combatant using shield and blade to protect allies while dishing out tactical damage.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Athletics, Fortitude, Influence, Perception, Insight, Archery

recommendedTalents.name: Shield Mastery
recommendedTalents.gloss: Reduce enemy attack Success Level with Quick Action

recommendedTalents.name: Stand your Ground
recommendedTalents.gloss: Resist being knocked prone or pushed with Quick Action

recommendedTalents.name: Second Wind
recommendedTalents.gloss: Regain HP with Quick Action once per scene

recommendedCombatArts.name: Defensive Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain Defend Action effects on hit

recommendedCombatArts.name: Charge
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Move and shove while attacking

recommendedCombatArts.name: Aimed Shot
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain +1 boon on a thrown attack when you don’t move

startingEquipment.note: thrown opener for the Archery rank 0 art

playstyle: The Fighter is perfect for players who want straightforward, effective combat with tactical depth. Use your shield to protect allies and your versatile longsword to adapt to situations. Stand your Ground keeps you in position while Second Wind provides survivability when needed. Combat Arts like Defensive Strike and Charge give you tactical options for different situations.
advancement: Increase Fighting and Fortitude to rank 2-3 for more Combat Arts and resilience, add Influence for battlefield command, consider Heavy Armor Mastery or more shield-focused talents.

name: Gladiator
description: An arena fighter who thrives on showmanship and crowd control, using sweeping greatsword strikes, grappling, and staged takedowns to dominate foes.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Athletics, Influence, Fortitude, Perception, Streetwise, Stealth

recommendedTalents.name: Heavy Weapon Mastery
recommendedTalents.gloss: No bane on Brutal Strike with heavy weapons

recommendedTalents.name: Grappler
recommendedTalents.gloss: Grapple on hit with unarmed/brawling weapons

recommendedTalents.name: Leading Presence
recommendedTalents.gloss: Allies near you gain boons to Initiative and vs fear

recommendedCombatArts.name: Brutal Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Deal extra Strength damage with heavy weapons

recommendedCombatArts.name: Cleave
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Hit multiple foes with a sweeping two‑handed strike

playstyle: The Gladiator is perfect for players who want flashy, high‑impact melee with crowd‑pleasing finishers. Use Grappler for clinches and showy takedowns, then unleash Brutal Strike for big single‑target hits or Cleave to cut through multiple foes. Work the battlefield, and the audience, while rallying allies with Leading Presence.
advancement: Increase Fighting to rank 2-3 for more Combat Arts, raise Athletics for better control and mobility, add Fortitude for resilience, and consider Shield Mastery or additional performance/social talents.

name: Hoplite
description: A formation fighter with spear and shield, representing the Bronze Age soldier's tactical prowess.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Athletics, Influence, Fortitude, Perception, Insight, Archery

recommendedTalents.name: Polearm Mastery
recommendedTalents.gloss: Opportunity attacks when enemies approach

recommendedTalents.name: Fast Stride
recommendedTalents.gloss: Use Dash as Quick Action

recommendedTalents.name: Leading Presence
recommendedTalents.gloss: Allies near you gain boons to Initiative and vs fear

recommendedCombatArts.name: Charge
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Move and shove while attacking

recommendedCombatArts.name: Defensive Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain Defend Action effects on hit

recommendedCombatArts.name: Pinning Shot
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: A hit with a thrown javelin drops the target’s Movement to 0

playstyle: The Hoplite is perfect for players who enjoy tactical positioning, defensive play, and Bronze Age military aesthetics. Control space with reach weapons and hold formation with allies. Polearm Mastery punishes enemies who approach, while Fast Stride allows repositioning. Leading Presence helps coordinate your unit. Use Charge for aggressive pushes and Defensive Strike to hold the line.
advancement: Increase Fighting to rank 2-3 for more Combat Arts, raise Athletics and Influence for tactical command, add Fortitude for resilience, consider Shield Mastery or Protective Stance, and save for heavier armor (Scale Mail 250 coins).

name: Magus
description: A melee fighter who infuses weapons with arcane magic, blending swordplay and spellcasting.
suggestedSkills: Arcana, Fighting, Education, Lore, Perception, Insight, Streetwise

recommendedTalents.name: Battle Mage
recommendedTalents.gloss: Quick Action arcane barrier adds Arcana to Parry/Dodge

recommendedTalents.name: Blade Mastery
recommendedTalents.gloss: Switch between pierce/slash properties

recommendedTalents.name: General Education
recommendedTalents.gloss: No bane on untrained expert skills when using Mind

recommendedCombatArts.name: Feint
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain +1 boon when not moving

recommendedCombatArts.name: Precise Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Ignore armor and add Agility to damage

playstyle: The Magus is perfect for players who want to combine melee combat with spellcasting in a hybrid warrior-mage. Blend swordplay with arcane magic. Battle Mage provides magical defense while you fight in melee. Blade Mastery gives combat versatility. Use spells to enhance your combat effectiveness. Use Feint for reliable attacks and Precise Strike against armored foes.
advancement: Increase Arcana and Fighting equally to rank 2-3 for more spells and Combat Arts, take Spellblade talent at higher ranks, add Lore for magical knowledge, and consider Battle Mage rank 2 for casting with Mind.

name: Monk
description: An unarmed combat specialist with superhuman toughness and grappling techniques.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Athletics, Fortitude, Insight, Perception, Mysticism, Education

recommendedTalents.name: Pugilist
recommendedTalents.gloss: Unarmed attacks deal 2 weapon damage, +1 Parry

recommendedTalents.name: Grappler
recommendedTalents.gloss: Grapple on hit with unarmed/brawling weapons

recommendedTalents.name: Body of Bronze
recommendedTalents.gloss: +2 HP, +1+Fortitude AV while unarmored

recommendedCombatArts.name: Choking Grip
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Restrain grappled targets

recommendedCombatArts.name: Knockout
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Stun enemies with crush attacks

playstyle: The Monk is perfect for players who want to fight without weapons or armor, using martial arts and grappling. Fight with fists and feet, using Grappler to control enemies and Body of Bronze for defense without armor. Pugilist makes unarmed strikes effective weapons. Your high mobility and control make you a disruptive force. Use Choking Grip to restrain dangerous foes and Knockout to take out heavily armored enemies.
advancement: Increase Fighting and Athletics to rank 2-3 for more Combat Arts and grappling options, raise Fortitude for more toughness, add Insight for reading opponents, and consider Martial Artist or more unarmed talents.

name: Oracle
description: A divine prophet who uses foresight and omens to guide allies and reveal hidden truths.
suggestedSkills: Mysticism, Lore, Insight, Education, Perception, Influence, Stealth

recommendedTalents.name: Divine Sense
recommendedTalents.gloss: Sense spirits/undead and hallowed or cursed auras

recommendedTalents.name: Consult the Myths
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re‑roll Lore about supernatural topics once per scene

recommendedTalents.name: Piercing Look
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re‑roll Insight to detect lies or motives once per scene

playstyle: The Oracle is perfect for players who enjoy support roles, being the party's guide, and themes of fate and prophecy. Use foresight and divination to guide allies and avoid danger. Piercing Look helps you understand others while your spells provide warnings and revelations. Divine Sense adds mystical perception beyond the mortal veil. Combine illusions from Twilight with revelations from Light for versatile support.
advancement: Increase Mysticism and Lore to rank 2-3 for more powerful spells and deeper knowledge, raise Insight for better intuition, learn more divination and revelation spells, add Education for broader knowledge, and consider prophecy-themed talents.

name: Priest
description: A divine spellcaster who heals and protects allies while holding the frontline with mace and shield.
suggestedSkills: Mysticism, Fighting, Lore, Influence, Insight, Fortitude, Education

recommendedTalents.name: Divine Rites
recommendedTalents.gloss: Regain half your Focus during a short break, limited uses per day

recommendedTalents.name: Shield Mastery
recommendedTalents.gloss: Reduce enemy attack Success Level with Quick Action

recommendedTalents.name: Consult the Myths
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re‑roll Lore about supernatural topics once per scene

recommendedCombatArts.name: Defensive Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain Defend Action effects on hit

recommendedCombatArts.name: Exhilarating Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Heal nearby allies on hit

playstyle: The Priest is perfect for players who want to support allies with healing and protection while remaining combat-effective. Balance divine magic with frontline fighting. Heal and protect allies while holding the line with shield and mace. Divine Rites helps you recover Focus between fights. Use Defensive Strike to stay alive and Exhilarating Strike to keep allies in the fight.
advancement: Increase Mysticism to rank 2-3 for more powerful spells, raise Fighting for better combat effectiveness and more Combat Arts, add Influence for religious authority, and consider Armor of the Faithful for unarmored defense builds.

name: Ranger
description: A ranged hunter with wilderness expertise who strikes from distance with precision while tracking prey.
suggestedSkills: Archery, Survival, Nature, Insight, Perception, Stealth, Fighting

recommendedTalents.name: Sharpshooter

recommendedTalents.name: Relentless Tracker

recommendedCombatArts.name: Evasive Strike

recommendedCompanions.name: Bird

recommendedCompanions.name: Bear

playstyle: The Ranger is perfect for players who enjoy ranged combat, wilderness survival, and having an animal companion. Strike from distance with precision while your animal companion provides tactical support. Sharpshooter allows effective long-range attacks, and Survival expertise makes you invaluable during wilderness travel. Use Aimed Shot for reliable damage and Precise Shot when facing armored foes.
advancement: Increase Archery to rank 2-3 for more Combat Arts and damage, raise Survival and Nature for wilderness mastery, add Perception for better awareness, and consider Disciplined Archer or Rapid Shot talents.

name: Rogue
description: A sneaky infiltrator who uses tricks, stealth, and precision strikes to eliminate targets.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Stealth, Streetwise, Insight, Perception, Athletics, Influence

recommendedTalents.name: Blade Mastery
recommendedTalents.gloss: Switch between pierce/slash properties

recommendedTalents.name: Assassination

recommendedCombatArts.name: Evasive Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain Retreat Action effects on hit

playstyle: The Rogue is perfect for players who enjoy stealth, infiltration, skill-based challenges, and being the party's scout. Rely on stealth, surprise, and precision strikes. Use Assassination to open with a stronger first hit from stealth, then keep the pressure on. Jack of All Trades keeps you adaptable in and out of cities. Blade Mastery gives you versatility in combat. Use Feint for reliable attacks and Evasive Strike to retreat safely.
advancement: Increase Stealth and Fighting to rank 2-3 for more options and Combat Arts, add Insight for reading people, consider Defensive Dueling or Riposte, and learn social skills for infiltration.

name: Shaman
description: A spirit medium who communes with ancestors to bless allies and curse enemies through spiritual power.
suggestedSkills: Mysticism, Nature, Lore, Insight, Survival, Perception, Influence

recommendedTalents.name: Divine Sense
recommendedTalents.gloss: Sense spirits/undead and hallowed or cursed auras

recommendedTalents.name: Field Medic
recommendedTalents.gloss: Save the dying. Treat wounds quickly during delves

recommendedTalents.name: Consult the Myths
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re‑roll Lore about supernatural topics once per scene

playstyle: The Shaman is perfect for players who enjoy spiritual themes, supporting through blessings, and connecting with ancestral powers. Bridge the physical and spirit worlds, calling on ancestors for aid. Use blessings to empower allies and curses to weaken enemies. Divine Sense and Field Medic make you invaluable to your community.
advancement: Increase Mysticism to rank 2-3 for more powerful spells, raise Lore for deeper spiritual knowledge, add Insight for reading people and spirits, and consider more spirit-themed talents.

name: Slinger
description: A mobile short-range skirmisher who uses slings and thrown weapons for hit-and-run tactics.
suggestedSkills: Archery, Athletics, Stealth, Survival, Perception, Insight, Nature

recommendedTalents.name: Expert Slinger
recommendedTalents.gloss: Supply checks for thrown bundles: roll twice, take higher

recommendedTalents.name: Fast Stride
recommendedTalents.gloss: Use Dash as Quick Action

recommendedTalents.name: Devious Tactics
recommendedTalents.gloss: Use Distract as a Quick Action. Set up openings

recommendedCombatArts.name: Aimed Shot
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain +1 boon when not moving

recommendedCombatArts.name: Power Shot
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Add Strength to damage

playstyle: The Slinger is perfect for players who want a mobile, hit-and-run playstyle with simple but effective ranged combat. Harass enemies from short range then reposition with Fast Stride. Expert Slinger makes your thrown bundles more reliable so your javelins keep flying. Devious Tactics lets you create distractions as a Quick Action to set up safe shots. Use Aimed Shot for reliable damage and Power Shot for finishing blows.
advancement: Increase Archery to rank 2-3 for more Combat Arts and damage, raise Athletics for mobility, add Survival for scouting, and consider Rapid Shot or more mobility talents.

name: Sorcerer
description: A glass cannon spellcaster who deals massive magical damage through raw arcane power.
suggestedSkills: Arcana, Lore, Education, Insight, Perception, Stealth, Influence

recommendedTalents.name: Mana Shield
recommendedTalents.gloss: On casting an arcane spell, gain AV (2 + spell rank) briefly

recommendedTalents.name: Magical Sense
recommendedTalents.gloss: Gain boons against magic. Intuit resistances and weaknesses

recommendedTalents.name: General Education
recommendedTalents.gloss: No bane on untrained expert skills with Mind

playstyle: The Sorcerer is perfect for players who want to deal massive magical damage and control the battlefield through spells. Unleash raw arcane power with devastating offensive spells. Mana Shield protects you when enemies get close. Your high Focus pool lets you cast many spells per scene.
advancement: Increase Arcana to rank 2-3 for more powerful spells and additional spells known, add Insight for better awareness, consider Spellweaver or Inexhaustible Mind talents, and learn spell combinations that work together.

name: Swashbuckler
description: A street-born duelist who fights dirty with feints, distractions, and flashy blade work. Excels with light weapons, mobility, and crowd-savvy tricks.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Stealth, Streetwise, Insight, Perception, Athletics, Influence

recommendedTalents.name: Dual Wielder
recommendedTalents.gloss: No banes when attacking with two light melee weapons

recommendedTalents.name: Devious Tactics
recommendedTalents.gloss: Use Distract as a Quick Action. Set up openings

recommendedTalents.name: Swashbuckler
recommendedTalents.gloss: +2 HP, on a hit with a light melee weapon, target can’t use Quick Actions against you this turn

recommendedCombatArts.name: Feint
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain +1 boon when not moving with non-heavy weapons

recommendedCombatArts.name: Disarm
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Attempt to disarm immediately after this attack

playstyle: The Swashbuckler thrives on movement, misdirection, and momentum. Use Devious Tactics to set up openings, then strike with dual light blades. Dual Wielder removes the usual banes for two-weapon attacks. Swashbuckler shuts down enemy Quick Actions after you hit, letting you press the attack without fear of counters. Use Feint for reliable advantage and Disarm to punish weaponed foes. Coat blades with poison for nasty burst when needed.
advancement: Raise Fighting to rank 2-3 for more Combat Arts (Supreme Feint, Quick Lunge, or Riposte). Boost Stealth for better scene control or pick Streetwise: Thug Tactics if you prefer gang-up brawling. Consider Defensive Dueling if you pivot to single-blade finesse. Add Fortitude for toughness and Influence for swagger-driven social play.

name: Summoner
description: An arcane conjurer who brings allies from beyond and shapes the field with glyphs and constructs.
suggestedSkills: Arcana, Lore, Insight, Education, Perception, Influence, Mysticism

recommendedTalents.name: Master of Fundamentals
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re‑roll one arcane rank 0 spell per scene

recommendedTalents.name: Magical Sense
recommendedTalents.gloss: Boons vs. magic. Intuit resistances and weaknesses

recommendedTalents.name: Piercing Look
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re‑roll Insight vs. lies/motives once per scene

recommendedFamiliars.name: Bat
recommendedFamiliars.gloss: Flying scout with echolocation and a poisoning bite.

recommendedFamiliars.name: Rat
recommendedFamiliars.gloss: Climbing scout with keen scent and a bleeding bite.

recommendedFamiliars.name: Spider
recommendedFamiliars.gloss: Web control once per scene for restraint.

playstyle: The Summoner controls tempo with glyphs and durable constructs while adding bodies to the field. Use Arcane Glyph for traps and Arcane Barrier for cover and lanes. Master of Fundamentals keeps cantrips reliable. Conjure Familiar gives you a versatile scout and support ally early. Later, Summon Aberration adds real battlefield presence.
advancement: Raise Arcana 2-3 for more spells and Focus. Consider Inexhaustible Mind or Spellweaver. Add Lore for arcane theory and Insight for reading foes. After your familiar, look to Summon Aberration and utility control like Arcane Eye.

name: Tamer
description: A non-magical animal handler who commands a loyal companion and controls space with a whip and clever tactics.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Nature, Athletics, Survival, Perception, Insight, Streetwise

recommendedTalents.name: Pugilist
recommendedTalents.gloss: Unarmed and brawling control pairs with whips and grapples

recommendedTalents.name: Animal Companion
recommendedTalents.gloss: Control an animal companion (Tier ≤ Nature)

recommendedTalents.name: Fast Stride
recommendedTalents.gloss: Use Dash as a Quick Action for better kiting and positioning

recommendedCombatArts.name: Disarm
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Attempt to disarm immediately after this attack

recommendedCombatArts.name: Snare
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Grapple and restrain with your weapon on a hit

recommendedCompanions.name: Dog
recommendedCompanions.gloss: Loyal tracker with pack tactics and reliable grapples.

recommendedCompanions.name: Cat
recommendedCompanions.gloss: Stealthy scout with pounce and knockdown.

recommendedCompanions.name: Boar
recommendedCompanions.gloss: Durable frontline that can gore on a charge.

playstyle: The Tamer locks lanes and creates openings for their animal. Use Fast Stride to kite. Disarm to strip threats. Snare to pin priority targets so your companion can maul them. Pugilist improves your baseline brawl control with whips and grapples. Your companion is your second body. Set up flanks and force bad choices.
advancement: Raise Nature 2-3 to deepen companion options. Fighting 2-3 for more Combat Arts (Supreme Disarm, Flurry). Add Athletics or Survival for mobility and fieldcraft. Consider Field Medic from Nature for downtime care.

name: Warlock
description: An eldritch spellcaster who wields dark pact magic to curse enemies and drain their life force.
suggestedSkills: Arcana, Lore, Insight, Influence, Perception, Stealth, Fortitude

recommendedTalents.name: Master of Fundamentals
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re-roll rank 0 spell tests once per scene

recommendedTalents.name: Arcane Spell Knowledge
recommendedTalents.gloss: Know +1 additional Arcana spell per rank

recommendedTalents.name: Piercing Look
recommendedTalents.gloss: Re‑roll Insight to detect lies or motives once per scene

playstyle: The Warlock is perfect for players who enjoy morally complex characters with manipulative magic and dark themes. Wield eldritch powers through a dark pact. Use mind control, curses, and drain effects to control enemies. Piercing Look helps you understand and manipulate others. Master of Fundamentals ensures your rank 0 spells remain reliable.
advancement: Increase Arcana to rank 2-3 for more powerful spells and additional spells known, raise Lore for deeper occult knowledge, add Fortitude for resilience against backlash, and consider Spellweaver for Metamagic Arts.

name: Warlord
description: A battlefield leader who commands allies and coordinates tactics through military expertise.
suggestedSkills: Fighting, Influence, Education, Fortitude, Insight, Perception, Athletics

recommendedTalents.name: Shield Mastery
recommendedTalents.gloss: Reduce enemy attack Success Level with Quick Action

recommendedTalents.name: Leading Presence
recommendedTalents.gloss: Allies near you gain boons to Initiative and vs fear

recommendedTalents.name: Commander
recommendedTalents.gloss: Grant allies movement or boons as Quick Action

recommendedCombatArts.name: Exhilarating Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Heal nearby allies on hit

recommendedCombatArts.name: Defensive Strike
recommendedCombatArts.gloss: Gain Defend Action effects on hit

playstyle: The Warlord is perfect for players who want to lead the party tactically, enhancing allies rather than focusing on personal combat. Command the battlefield through tactical positioning and support. Commander lets you reposition allies or grant them advantages. Leading Presence makes you a natural leader. Shield Mastery protects you while you direct the battle. Use Exhilarating Strike to heal allies and Defensive Strike to stay alive while commanding.
advancement: Increase Fighting and Influence to rank 2-3 for more Combat Arts and leadership abilities, raise Education for tactical options, add Fortitude for survivability, and consider more command-focused talents.
